verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-defined event-triggered automation rules, such as auto-disabling a gate when a metric regresses. What it does show is adjacent: Scheduled Rollouts are time-based rather than event-triggered, Autotune is a built-in bandit algorithm rather than a user-defined rule, Infra Analytics alerts only notify, and CLI use in CI/CD is a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
